items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: David, I guess, is for perhaps Dave Brubeck, I don't know.

ctx.x: Miraculously entertaining. If you think you like us, wait until you hear his stuff. But there's no market for it, you know. There's no radio station except one station in Brooklyn that uh, uh broadcasts uh, music from Trinidad. Um, maybe four hours every Saturday or something like that. And Dave goes on there all the time. In fact when he did his latest production, he was on there [chuckles] and uh, you, you, you, I presume that noticed his accent. Have you not?
